description: A provider backend end to end: create, challenge at the declared URL, activate, a work notification, claim through /mcp. The notification is an unchanged http-wake body.

steps.does: tools/call envoi_wake_create with a URL on a declared origin
sends one signed wake.challenge to that URL (http-wake §3.2); no OAuth token or secret travels in it
verifies the signature against the key set, then calls envoi_wake_activate with the challenge
sends wake.work_available/subscription_activated, then wake.work_available/message_delivered when work arrives (http-wake §2.3, opaque)
acknowledges within the timeout, then calls envoi_claim_work with its own OAuth access token at /mcp, never a URL taken from the notification
on every start and at most every 900 s reads envoi_wake_status and claims once
